name: मुख्यमंत्री माझी लाडकी बहीण योजना
description: State scheme providing monthly financial assistance to eligible women residents of Maharashtra.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance credited via DBT to eligible women.
eligibility: Women aged 21-65 residing in Maharashtra, meeting income and other criteria as notified.
steps: Register on the Ladki Bahin portal or Narishakti Doot app.
Submit and note the application number.
Track approval and DBT credit status.
